characters.name: 老周
characters.design: 46-year-old male food delivery rider with stubble, obvious tired lines under eyes, wearing worn dark blue windbreaker with faint delivery platform logos, habitually lowering his head, natural weathered skin texture, medium shot from waist up to show his humble and tired demeanor, consistent with rainy night ambient lighting.

characters.name: 周小雨
characters.design: 11-year-old girl with wet hair stuck to her forehead, wearing oversized school uniform, carrying old canvas backpack, soft young face, slightly drooping eyes, medium shot from waist up, wet school uniform fabric texture visible, consistent with cool ambient light of rainy night.

props.name: 凉掉的白包子
props.design: Half-eaten plain steamed bun with slightly dry, hardened crust, faint oil stains on surface, plain white with soft warm tone, placed in rough paper bag, close-up shot to show the simple, warm detail of father sharing food with daughter.

issues: 设计要点要求被咬过的凉馒头，画面为完整且冒热气的馒头
设计要点要求表面有油渍，画面未见明显油渍
设计要点要求放在粗糙纸袋中，画面为纸盒

props.name: 旧帆布书包
props.design: Frayed edge plain canvas backpack with faded school logo, worn shoulder straps with slight deformation, dark blue base color with faint stains, placed on wet ground of bus stop, side view to show its worn texture, consistent with rainy night wet details.

scenes.name: 城郊深夜公交站
scenes.design: Suburban bus stop at late night, wet ground reflecting warm yellow street lamp light, faded advertising light box with faint glow, distant highway traffic as blurred bokeh light spots, light rain falling, cool desaturated color grade with subtle warm highlights, wide shot to show the lonely and warm waiting atmosphere.

scenes.name: 末班公交内景
scenes.design: Interior of late-night last bus, empty fabric seats, cold white ceiling fluorescent light, rain streaks on windows with faint reflection of passengers, dim cool color tone, medium shot from inside the bus to show the quiet space stopping at the station.
